clauses.text:
EXECUTIVE ORDER 10570
Creating an Emergency Board to Inves­
tigate a Dispute Between the Pull­
man Company and Certain op Its
Employees
WHEREAS a dispute exists between
The Pullman Company, a carrier, and
certain of its employees represented by
the Order of Railway Conductors and
Brakemen, a labor organization; and
WHEREAS this dispute has not here­
tofore been adjusted under the provi­
sions of the Railway Labor Act, as
amended; and
WHEREAS this dispute, in the judg­
ment of the National Mediation Board,
threatens substantially to interrupt in­
terstate commerce to a degree such as
to deprive a section of the country of
essential transportation service:
NOW, THEREFORE, by virtue of the
authority vested in me by section 10 of
the Railway Labor Act, as amended (45
U. S. C. 160), I hereby create a board of
three members, to be appointed by me,
to investigate the said dispute. No mem­
ber of the said board shall be pecuniarily
or otherwise interested in any organiza­
tion of railway employees or any carrier.
The board shall report its findings to
the President with respect to the said
dispute within thirty days from the date
of this order.
As provided by section 10 of the Rail­
way Labor Act, as amended, from this
date and for thirty days after the board
has made its report to the President, no
change, except by agreement, shall be
made by The Pullman Company, or by
its employees, in the conditions out of
which the said dispute arose.

versions.research_rationale:
EO 10570 is a single-paragraph Railway Labor Act section 10 emergency board order. Its only commands are creation of the board, a thirty-day report deadline and a recited statutory standstill. Under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 (report deadline, option C) none of those ends the order; the first held end is the express revocation by EO 12553 on 1986-02-25 (signature date, no effective-date wording). The board's report date 1954-11-20 is a spent fact recorded in the clause reason. Savings: none found in EO 12553 or in the order itself. Searches: U.S. Code and eCFR number-citation searches found no hit for this order; the OFR disposition-note search lists only the EO 12553 revocation in the chain.

The order creates no continuing right, office or appropriation. No other command in the order survives the board's report.","savings_check":"The text of EO 12553 contains no savings, exception, effective-date or notwithstanding wording (the held text was searched for those terms). The board's investigation, report and the standstill were spent in the 1950s, and the order created no accrued right or later-effective duty. The statute the order invokes is not affected by revoking the order.","scope_check":"One clause covers the whole order; the order has no partial-scope command, no exception and no delayed effective date. The revocation in EO 12553 has no exception text, so it reaches the whole order."}
